summary.tldr: Introduces Multi-Axis Self-Attention (Max-SA), decomposing full attention into local Block Attention (local window) and global Grid Attention (dilated grid), delivering linear-complexity global receptive fields.
keyTakeaways: Combines MBConv depthwise convolutions with local Block Attention and global Grid Attention in a unified MaxViT block.
Grid Attention computes sparse global self-attention across pixels spaced at fixed grid intervals (dilated attention).
Achieves state-of-the-art 89.5% top-1 ImageNet-1K accuracy without extra external pre-training.

motivation.problemStatement: Vision Transformers face a fundamental trade-off: global self-attention (ViT) has quadratic O(N^2) complexity, while local window attention (Swin) lacks global receptive fields within a single block.
previousLimitations: Swin Transformer requires shifting windows across multiple layers to communicate globally.
Pure Vision Transformers lack local spatial translation inductive bias provided by convolutions.
Existing hybrid models concatenated CNN and Transformer stages sequentially rather than integrating them inside every block.
motivation.coreInsight: Decomposing 2D spatial self-attention into two sparse factorized axes—local Block Attention (partitioning HxW into PxP blocks) and global Grid Attention (partitioning HxW into GxG sparse grids)—achieves global receptive coverage in a single block with linear complexity O(HW).
contributions: Designed the MaxViT block combining MBConv, Block-SA, and Grid-SA.
Established state-of-the-art results on ImageNet, COCO, and ADE20K.

innovations.title: Multi-Axis Self-Attention (Max-SA)
innovations.summary: Sequentially applies local Block Attention (within PxP spatial blocks) and sparse Grid Attention (across uniform GxG grid positions).
innovations.detailedDescription: Block Attention captures fine-grained local interactions within non-overlapping windows. Grid Attention reshapes the spatial tensor into a sparse grid, attending to pixels that are far apart, achieving global receptive coverage in O(HW) complexity.

math.latexFormula: \text{Complexity}_{Max-SA} = O(P^2 \cdot H \cdot W + G^2 \cdot H \cdot W) = O(H \cdot W)
math.explanation: Linear FLOP complexity of Multi-Axis Attention for image resolution HxW, block size P=7, and grid size G=7.

variables.description: Global sparse grid sampling dimension (typically G=7)

math.significance: Provides global receptive field coverage in a single block at linear computational cost.

ablationStudies.title: Grid Attention vs Window Shifted Attention
ablationStudies.description: Compared MaxViT Grid Attention against Swin shifted window attention.
ablationStudies.removedComponent: Grid Attention (replaced with shifted window SW-MSA)
ablationStudies.performanceDelta: Grid Attention achieved 0.6% higher top-1 accuracy by capturing global context in a single block.

evidence.reproducibilityNotes: Trained using AdamW with momentum 0.9, weight decay 0.05, and RandAugment data augmentation.

criticalNotes.title: Global Receptive Coverage per Block
criticalNotes.content: Grid Attention grants every token a global receptive field within a single forward block pass.

criticalNotes.title: Tensor Permute & Reshape Overhead
criticalNotes.content: Interleaving block and grid dimensions requires multiple GPU tensor transpose operations.

reference.originalAbstract: In this paper, we introduce MaxViT, a simple and effective multi-axis vision transformer architecture that efficiently expands global receptive fields in early network layers.
